bead-forge - Drop-in replacement for beads_rust (br)

Usage: bf [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create         Create a new bead
  list           List beads
  show           Show bead details
  update         Update a bead
  close          Close a bead
  reopen         Reopen a bead
  delete         Delete a bead
  ready          Show ready (unblocked) beads
  claim          Claim a bead (atomic)
  init           Initialize a new workspace
  sync           Sync (flush to JSONL or import from JS

Create a new bead

Generates a unique short ID and prints it. Type defaults to "task" and priority to 2 (Normal); 0 is Critical, 4 is Backlog. Pass --label repeatedly to attach multiple labels.

Usage: bf create [OPTIONS] --title <TITLE>

Options:
      --title <TITLE>
          Title for the bead

  -w, --workspace <WORKSPACE>
          Workspace directory (defaults to current directory's .beads/)

      --no-auto-flush
          Disable auto-flush for this invocation (overrides config sync.aut

Doctor - check and repair

Checks database integrity, JSONL validity, and drift between the two. --repair rebuilds SQLite from JSONL (flush unflushed beads first with --flush-first to avoid losing them). --reclaim-stale resets beads stuck in_progress past the claim TTL back to open.

Usage: bf doctor [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --repair
          Rebuild database from JSONL

  -w, --workspace <WORKSPACE>
          Workspace directory (defaults to current directory's .beads/)

      --flush-first

Manage dependencies

Subcommands to add, remove, list, or tree dependencies between beads. A "blocks" dependency marks the blocked bead as Blocked until its blocker closes.

Usage: bf dep [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  add     Add a dependency
  remove  Remove a dependency
  list    List dependencies of an issue
  tree    Show dependency tree rooted at issue
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -w, --workspace <WORKSPACE>
          Workspace directory
